p: DeVito is preparing to play quarterback with Maye absent and is expected to be decisive and get the offense into the right plays.
DeVito appears to be the quarterback the offense is built around right now, though Vrabel never explicitly named him the starter and the pass rush exposed him last time.
I think he's taken advantage of his opportunities.
Tommy DeVito will start at QB for the Patriots against the Chargers while Drake Maye is out.
DeVito is the confirmed starter, and no QB addition is expected in the next few days, so NE pass-game expectations hinge on him.
DeVito replaced Maye mid-game and could be the quarterback if Maye misses time.
If Maye is out, DeVito's limited experience makes the passing game a downgrade, though Vrabel says the full playbook is available to him.
